name: negative-control-unrelated-fairness-papers
description: Not a plagiarism case -- a negative control. Two legitimate, unrelated papers on different subtopics (individual-fairness classifier theory vs. commercial face-classifier auditing) should NOT be flagged as near-duplicates. Guards against find_duplicates.py being too permissive (false positives), the way carlini-roadmap-2022 guards against it being too strict (false negatives). Empirically the lowest max cross-paper similarity observed across the whole 11-paper main corpus (0.540), picked for maximum separation from the threshold.
